name: measurement
doc: One measured value or count at a point in time, such as a weight, a blood pressure reading or a tally of glasses of water.

texts.label: Measurement
texts.help: A measured value or a count at a point in time, such as a weight.

help_translations.de: Ein gemessener Wert oder eine Zählung zu einem Zeitpunkt, etwa ein Gewicht.

fields.name: quantity
fields.doc: What was measured or counted, as the user calls it, such as Weight or Glasses of water.

texts.label: Quantity
texts.help: What was measured or counted, such as Weight or Glasses of water.

help_translations.de: Was gemessen oder gezählt wurde, etwa Gewicht oder Gläser Wasser.

fields.name: value
fields.doc: The measured value or the count, in unit.

texts.label: Value
texts.help: The measured value or the count.

help_translations.de: Der gemessene Wert oder die Anzahl.

fields.name: unit
fields.doc: The unit of value as a case-sensitive code of UCUM, such as kg, Cel or mm[Hg]. A count is 1, or an annotation in braces alone that names what is counted, such as {glass}.

texts.label: Unit
texts.help: The unit as a code of UCUM, such as kg; 1 for a count.

help_translations.de: Die Einheit als Code von UCUM, etwa kg; 1 für eine Anzahl.

fields.name: measured_at
fields.doc: When the value was measured or counted.

texts.label: Measured at
texts.help: When the value was measured or counted.

help_translations.de: Wann der Wert gemessen oder gezählt wurde.

fields.name: subject
fields.doc: Who or what was measured, as text, such as the name of a pet. Empty when it is the user.

texts.label: Subject
texts.help: Who or what was measured, such as the name of a pet; empty for the user.

help_translations.de: Wer oder was gemessen wurde, etwa der Name eines Tiers; leer für den Nutzer selbst.

fields.name: notes
fields.doc: Free notes on the measurement, as plain text; lines are separated by LF. Empty when there are none.

fields.name: relations
fields.doc: The relations of the record to other records and to things outside AXT (spec/types.md, section 8), in the order the user gave them. Empty when it has none.

texts.label: Relations
texts.help: Entries and other things this one is linked to, such as the pets an appointment is for.

help_translations.de: Einträge und anderes, mit denen dieser verknüpft ist, etwa die Tiere, für die ein Termin ist.
